findings.title: A 2xx answer from Brevo without a messageId fails the row and calls the fallback, though the e-mail may have gone
steps: Brevo answers 201 with a body that has no messageId
findings.evidence: The comment says `// Accepted without an id: the e-mail may have gone, so it is not retried.` but the row is still set `failed` and the fallback runs. Once ST-196 plugs push into the fallback, a delivered e-mail would also send a push. Consider marking it sent without an id, or failing it without the fallback.

findings.title: The retry log line has no type or channel
findings.evidence: `notification ${rows[0].id} will be retried: ${error.reason}`. FR-020 says notification logs carry the id, type, channel and outcome, and the failure line in NotificationsService.fail carries all four. The worker log of this run shows: "notification 75398ec0-… will be retried: provider_503".
